description: This file defines the main class 'Daux' for the Daux documentation generator. It manages configuration, content type handling, tree generation, output handling, processor integration, and format generation within the project.

classes.name: Daux
classes.description: Main controller class for the Daux documentation generator, managing configuration, content processing, tree building, and format generation.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Builds and finalizes the documentation content tree based on current configuration.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current Config object, initializing it with the tree if not already done.

methods.name: getProcessor
methods.description: Returns the current Processor instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setProcessor
methods.description: Sets a custom Processor instance and updates the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getGenerators
methods.description: Returns the available content generators with possible extensions.

methods.name: getProcessorClass
methods.description: Determines and returns the class name of the configured processor, with validation.

methods.name: findAlternatives
methods.description: Finds strings similar to the input within a list, based on Levenshtein distance.

methods.name: getGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns the content generator instance based on current configuration.

methods.name: getContentTypeHandler
methods.description: Provides the content type handler, combining base and extended types.

methods.name: getContentExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of valid content file extensions for the project.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the output interface, instantiated as NullOutput if none exists.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs a message to the configured output, without ending with a newline.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Outputs a message to the configured output with a newline.

methods.name: getVerbosity
methods.description: Returns the current verbosity level of the output.
